CLASS Taban
    PUBLIC
    VIRTUAL METHOD Deger() AS I32
        RETURN 10
    END METHOD
    METHOD ViaThis() AS I32
        RETURN THIS.Deger()
    END METHOD
    METHOD ViaMe() AS I32
        RETURN ME.Deger()
    END METHOD
    METHOD Plain() AS I32
        RETURN Deger()
    END METHOD
END CLASS
CLASS Alt EXTENDS Taban
    PUBLIC
    OVERRIDE METHOD Deger() AS I32
        RETURN 20
    END METHOD
    METHOD ViaSuper() AS I32
        RETURN SUPER.Deger()
    END METHOD
END CLASS
DIM o AS Alt = NEW Alt()
